The body starts on the very next line: there is no blank line between it and the closing fence,
so a parser that skips one newline after the fence would eat the first character of this note.
markdown-rs reports the block's span *without* the closing fence's line terminator, which is
exactly the off-by-one this fixture catches.

This file also has no final newline, which is the other classic byte-identity trap. The last
byte of this file is a full stop.
